question: Where’s the closest golf course in the southwestward direction from Feather Factory Hotel, Long Island City, NY?
sql: WITH hotel_location AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Feather Factory Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Long Island City%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), golf_courses_data AS ( (SELECT poi_name AS name, geometry FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'golf_course') UNION ALL (SELECT park_name AS name, geometry FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course') ) SELECT gc.name FROM golf_courses_data gc, hotel_location hl WHERE degrees(ST_Azimuth(hl.geom::geography, gc.geometry::geography)) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5 ORDER BY ST_Distance(hl.geom::geography, gc.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;

metadata.final_exec_err: ST_Azimuth(geography, geography) is only valid for point inputs
